youtube_title: Tired of praying the same prayer? | Psalm 13
youtube_description:
Ever prayed the same prayer so many times you're tired of hearing yourself? David asks God "How long?" four times in two verses (Psalm 13:1-2).

Then one small word turns the whole psalm: "But I have trusted in your steadfast love" (Psalm 13:5). Steadfast love is the Hebrew chesed (KHEH-sed): God's loyal, covenant love. Love that doesn't quit. David doesn't hide the question. He just doesn't let it have the last word.

Today's step: write down your own "how long." Then write one line under it that starts with "but."

Day 13 of the Psalms, one chapter a day. Follow @thebibleexplainedai so you don't miss Psalm 14.

Read it: Psalm 13:1-6
